why: Turns the HUD root back into a block. Every grid property stays written, and all of them stop meaning anything: `grid-row: 2` on the toast rail and capacity flash is ignored, their containing block becomes the whole HUD, and `top: 12px` / `top: 4px` put both at the top of the screen under the topbar at every viewport, not just a notched one. Nothing in either overlay's own rule changes, which is why the guard reads the root.
killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole places the toast rail and capacity flash from the topbar row, not a guessed height
